description: Uitdagingen-curation (Water & Bodem): drie beleidsknoppen voor riparian development — twee marker-enforcement-varianten en één buffer-variatie.

scenarios.name: Overstroombaar gebied treated as hard exclusion
scenarios.description: FR-WA-03 (art. 2.16, overstroombaar gebied, 1207 km²) is a conditional marker in the baseline; the strictest water-safety reading excludes new riparian development there entirely.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-WA-03 (art. 2.16) conditions development on differentiating binnendijks/buitendijks; this variant executes the strictest reading as a hard exclusion of the overstroombaar gebied.

scenarios.name: Vrijwaringszone regionale waterkering treated as hard exclusion
scenarios.description: FR-WA-01 (art. 2.14, 28 km²) is a conditional marker; this variant protects the waterkering function by excluding development in the vrijwaringszone.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-WA-01 (art. 2.14) requires plans to protect the waterkering's function; this variant executes the protective reading as a hard exclusion.

scenarios.name: Waterbergingsgebied exclusion widened by a 500 m band
scenarios.description: Buffers the art.-2.15 waterbergingsgebied exclusion (FR-WA-02) outward by 500 m — a hydrological-safety-margin variant.

basis.variedAspect: exclusion zone widened by an added 500 m buffer; the exclusion itself is cited, the 500 m margin is the scenario's own parameter
basis.provenanceNote: NC-WA-02 (art. 2.15) rules out new development in the waterbergingsgebied; the 500 m widening is not cited and is the scenario's own parameter.
